environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on EC2 in a private subnet. S3 access is exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that restricts operations by condition key 'aws:PrincipalTag/team' = 'catalog-readonly-consumers'. The endpoint policy allows s3:GetObject unconditionally but DENIES s3:PutObject unless the calling principal has the tag 'team' = 'catalog-publishers' AND the request includes the condition 'aws:ResourceTag/mutable' = 'true'. The prod-catalog-store bucket objects do NOT carry the resource tag 'mutable=true' (objects are tagged 'mutable=false' via S3 default tagging configuration). Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway or NAT gateway, so S3 is ONLY reachable through this VPC endpoint. The application IAM role has the principal tag 'team' = 'catalog-readonly-consumers'.

config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, internal ALB
config.s3_access: Exclusively via Gateway VPC Endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
config.iam_role: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/catalog-api-role with s3:GetObject,s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::prod-catalog-store/*, PrincipalTag team=catalog-readonly-consumers
config.s3_default_tagging: All objects in prod-catalog-store tagged with mutable=false
config.redis: ElastiCache Redis 6.x, AUTH enabled with token rotation, same VPC
